notes: scan036.N1 The page describes group actions associated with a morphism of two restricted sets, then gives a diagonal marginal interpretation using invariants and begins the example of a topological surface with one marked point. This is a summary of the written page, not a proof.

scan036.N2 The main clause begins with capital Quand after a number now left unsure as 10 / 1° following blind review, with no opening parenthesis visible. A separate closing parenthesis after connexes is clear and retained. The apparent imbalance was not silently repaired.
scan036.N3 The written marginal wording is cela veut que. The low beginning of the second word rules against dit; no dire appears between veut and que. No word was supplied to improve the French.

scan036.N4 The starred disk has a subscript 0, a small closed oval without the exit stroke of the neighboring a. The surrounding phrase still says autour de a. The notation is preserved; this page alone does not show whether an origin coordinate or an authorial slip was intended.

scan036.N5 The apparent quadrilateral near original box [316,920,448,1045] is not treated as an independent drawing. Its horizontal upper stroke belongs to main-text comme; the longer angled strokes belong to the descender/return in diagonal marginal lequel. The isolated sides are not a coherent separately drawn diagram. Crops r15, r08 and r16 document the crossing. No running word was drawn as TikZ.

scan036.N6 The bottom-left 35 is pale foliation in another hand. It is retained separately with a margin macro and an explanatory source comment, not attributed to the author as his own page numbering.

scan036.N7 I visually read the complete page image for layout and both supplied full-resolution halves, then inspected all 19 saved crops. No OCR, external research, other manuscript page, other reader report, or TeX compilation was used. The count of 30 written lines/items comprises 19 main baselines including the top display, 8 marginal prose baselines, the marginal formula, its underbrace label, and the foliation.

scan036.N8 The full marginal crop was rotated clockwise 55 degrees for reading. Its source box remains in the coordinates of the original 1688 by 2363 page image. Crossing main-text fragments are accounted for in the main-text transcription; they are not extra words in the margin.

scan036.N10 Targeted check of the marginal invariants step: if I is the kernel of D→Π₁(Y) and E_{Y,X} has trivial I-action as stated, D-equivariance of φ gives i·φ(e)=φ(i·e)=φ(e) for every i∈I. This checks only that local step under the written hypotheses; it does not verify the earlier referenced diagrams.
